scope: Six selected project stories, with tools and concrete workflows. No usage metrics or new employment dates added.

aether.supports: Branching conversations, React Flow, context sidebar, streaming, files, browser storage, and stack.

agentex.supports: Floating generation panel, configuration side panel, LaTeX and PDF workflow, model choice, knowledge base, and custom prompts.
agentex.limit: Fact-preservation is described as prompt intent, not a guarantee against fabricated output. No privacy or security guarantee copied from the README.

gitcue.supports: CLI and VS Code workflows, activity settling, thresholds, cancellation during buffer time, configurable commits and pushes.
gitcue.limit: README performance percentages were not reused.

mesa.supports: Museum purpose, interactive 3D room and books, chapter navigation, book-style content, and video.
mesa.limit: Individual role and kiosk work are retained from Sri's original site. The repository describes the collaborative application and does not establish sole authorship.

csdna.supports: Image upload, dot detection, clustering, parameter controls, researcher labels, GPU and CPU paths, plots, and exports.

soda.supports: Shared Flask platform and Discord bots; public web source contains React; authored onboarding documentation.
soda.limit: A merge commit does not establish authorship of every changed file. Leadership and workshops come from the original site; no new impact metrics added. The onboarding guide's setup details conflict with the current README, so they were not used to describe current architecture.
